episode_title: AI Stocks Tumble, Permitting Reform Bill Clears Senate, Confusion Over Medicaid Cuts
script_en: AI Stocks Tumble, Permitting Reform Bill Clears Senate, Confusion Over Medicaid Cuts.
Financial markets suffer major losses as concerns over an AI bubble grow.
A bipartisan bill that would speed up energy construction projects and weaken environmental regulations clears the US Senate.
Confusion grows over new Medicaid work requirement rules set to begin in January.
